name: Myrmidon
lore: Painted over every frontier sword-school door: BE FAST OR BE ELSEWHERE. Tuition is paid in debts, and in scars for the slow.
description: Fences with high skill and blistering speed. A drawn-out fight, though, is where it bleeds out.

name: Knight
lore: 'Can't run, can't dodge, can't be killed. Stand that one in the doorway and go find lunch.' A drill sergeant's verdict on the levy's newest knight.
description: All armor, no hurry. Soaks enormous punishment, then fails to catch anything that runs.

name: Fighter
lore: Quarry foreman to the levy officer: 'Take them. They hit what they swing at about half the time, and nothing gets up from the other half.'
description: Swings an axe hard enough to matter and eats hits well, though the aim and the luck both wander.

name: Cavalier
lore: Posted at every province remount office: RIDERS WANTED, ANY DUTY, ANY WEATHER. Mount provided. The old oath is no longer required.
description: Lance and mount, steady in every stat. The dependable body for any lineup.

name: Archer
lore: Border mothers tell children bound for the yeomanry: stand two paces back, and if they get close, run. A bow is no use at arm's length.
description: Deadly at two tiles, dead weight at one.

name: Mage
lore: Primer, lesson one: read the words aloud and the fire follows. Lesson two, circled twice by the last owner: never let them reach you.
description: Burns through armor with raw magic. A single solid hit ends the lesson.

name: Cleric
lore: Prayer of the field clerics: let me mend what they break, and never ask me to break it back. The staff was not made for striking.
description: Keeps the army standing turn after turn. Cannot land a blow of her own.

name: Thief
lore: Wanted on the provincial roads: slight, quick, sees in the dark. Last seen leaving a locked vault with the lock. The reward was in the vault.
description: Fastest boots on the field, keen eyes in the fog, and no lock slows her. Armor does.

name: Dancer
lore: When dancers come through a camp, spent soldiers get up and march one more mile. Quartermasters have tried to requisition that. It does not keep.
description: Her dance hands an ally a second action — the rarest, most prized support a lord can field.

name: Pegasus Knight
lore: Sky-legion saying: the mount picks the rider, the wind picks the road, and some farm boy with a bow picks the day you come down.
description: Rides the wind above every wall and shrugs off magic. An archer's arrow brings her down.

name: Wyvern Rider
lore: Mountain-clan price for a broken wyvern: one herd of goats, one winter's salt, and a promise to keep the beast clear of tower mages.
description: Tough and strong on the wing. Magic finds the gaps in the scales.

name: Mercenary
lore: Standard sellsword contract: paid monthly, fed daily, buried at the employer's expense. Any post, any weapon, no questions past the fee.
description: No wasted stat, no glaring gap. The sellsword you can slot anywhere and trust.

name: Swordmaster
lore: Tavern claim: nobody has ever seen a swordmaster's second stroke. Tavern answer, from the corner table: nobody has ever needed one.
description: Innate +15 crit turns any swing into an execution.

name: General
lore: Muster roll, west gate: General, one. Remarks: will not move, cannot be moved. Assigned the gate. Gate has stopped asking for reinforcements.
description: Doctrine made flesh: gains axes and shrugs off nearly every physical blow.

name: Warrior
lore: Levy clerks write 'warrior' beside any axe-hand who lives three winters. By then most have found a bow as well, and learned to hit with it.
description: Hits like a falling tree, and bows now give the swing reach.

name: Paladin
lore: The paladin oath as recited today: strength, shield, and service. The fourth line, about whom the strong must serve, is generally hummed.
description: Swords, extra reach, and defenses that lean nowhere — the knight the old oaths still fit.

name: Sniper
lore: Cover is for other archers. Each garrison keeps one sniper per wall, and the roster lists the post but never the name.
description: No cover saves the target; this shot ignores terrain dodge entirely.

name: Sage
lore: Academy transcript, final line: permitted past the approved pages. Also issued a healing staff, since the later chapters tend to hurt.
description: Keeps its devastating magic and picks up healing staves besides.

name: Bishop
lore: Investiture rite: a staff for those who kneel, light for those who will not. Wounds near a bishop close on their own, prayed for or not.
description: Light magic to strike with, and a mend that arrives each turn on its own.

name: Assassin
lore: Treasury ledger, line 40: services, unspecified. Paid in full. Recipient, unnamed. Target, see obituaries. Bow purchased separately.
description: A hit that can simply end a life, now with bows for the foes out of reach.

name: Bard
lore: Bards carry the border ballads through checkpoints that cannot tax a song, along with a mending staff and the knack of getting a spent soldier to go again.
description: Refreshes allies for another action and mends them with staves between songs.

name: Falcon Knight
lore: Sky-legion honors list: flew escort for the seers, outran three storms, landed only where hope was thinnest. Arrows, noted in the margin, still hurt.
description: Fast, warded, and now sword-armed, she commands the sky on grace alone.

name: Wyvern Lord
lore: When a wyvern lord's shadow crosses a mountain village, the arguing stops. Clan disputes have been settled that way for longer than anyone counts.
roleChange: Gains Axes, heavy flying bruiser, Draconic Aura innate
description: Axes, crushing bulk, and a shadow that owns the airspace it crosses.

name: Hero
lore: The word is a rank, not a compliment — given by soldiers, never by command, and never taken back.
description: Axes in hand and Sol to mend himself mid-swing; a veteran with no seam to exploit.

name: Lord
lore: Border banner-houses keep one custom above the rest: the lord walks in front and learns every name behind him. Soldiers stand taller for being counted.
description: Steadies nearby allies with a Charisma aura and only sharpens as the war grinds on.

name: Tactician
lore: War-college exam, final question: where is the enemy you cannot see? Graduates answered in board notation. The empire closed the colleges soon after.
description: Reads the field farther through fog and answers it with magic.

name: Ranger
lore: Border wardens keep two ledgers, patrol routes and the dead, and both run long. A wounded ranger is still standing, which makes him the dangerous kind.
role: Tanky melee, Resolve at low HP
description: Hard to drop and harder once wounded — Resolve sharpens him as the blood runs.

name: Light Sage
lore: Lay students of the seer order carry the light cupped close, and the wounded mend faster standing beside them. The war cut their studies short.
description: Light magic in one hand, a healing aura for nearby allies in the other.

name: Great Lord
lore: The border chronicles give the title to a lord who carries a lost crown's weight into the front rank and still knows every soldier by name.
description: The crown's weight settled; gains lances, more reach, and leads from the front rank.

name: Grandmaster
lore: The war colleges' last rank, earned by beating the headmaster at the board. Grandmasters carry a sword as well, because some opponents flip the table.
description: Mastered magic, with swords added on top. Almost nothing it cannot answer.

name: Vanguard
lore: First name on every breach roster, a rank awarded posthumously more often than not.
description: First through every breach: gains axes, piles on STR and DEF, and simply does not stop.

name: Light Priestess
lore: Last page of the liturgy, read aloud only at a priestess's vow: what sleeps below, what wakes it, and the thread by which the world is pulled back.
description: Mastered light to smite with, staves to mend with — the order's highest office.

name: Chevalier
lore: Long-march riders swear the charge is all skill. Villagers who watch one spear a scarecrow at full gallop call it luck, and step well back from the road.
description: The farther he charges, the harder he lands; deadly reach across open ground.

name: Holy Knight
lore: Consecrated at the ruined temples with a lance and a staff. Holy knights call the blessing a formality; the mending works either way, and so does the lance.
description: A surge of magic, plus staves and Light — one saddle to heal from or to strike from.

name: Sky Lancer
lore: Sky-legion picket orders: fly alone, keep your distance, report what the ground can't see. Sky lancers take this as permission, and fly best with nobody near.
description: Cut loose from the pack she flies faster and dodges more. Keep her clear of archers.

name: Seraph Knight
lore: Chronicle of the far pickets: a few sky lancers flew high enough that the light took notice. They came down with it running along the lance, and kept it.
description: Light magic for mixed damage and a longer reach on the wing.

name: Sentinel
lore: Sentinel drill, entire: stand there. Advanced drill: keep standing there. Whoever swings at a sentinel first learns why the drill is so short.
description: Enormous bulk that punishes whoever dares to strike it first.

name: Champion
lore: Every province had one, the fighter other fighters walk around. Champions took up the lance so nobody could walk around them from farther off.
description: Owns close quarters with lances now, and staying power nothing wears through.

name: Duelist
lore: Dueling-hall rule: never strike first, never refuse a challenge. Duelists keep both vows by standing very still and letting the fool swing.
description: Counters better than most units attack; gains lances and thrives on being struck at.

name: Great Knight
lore: Requisition, heavy horse: one plate harness, trimmed. One destrier, large. Lance, axe, sword. Remarks: slower than cavalry, far faster than a knight.
roleChange: Gains Axes/Swords, Cavalry, Canto, Armored Blow innate
description: Wall enough and horse enough at once — trades pure armor for speed and Canto after acting.

name: Berserker
lore: The berserk school teaches one lesson: bleed, and keep swinging. Pupils who learn it too well are chained at night, which the school calls graduation.
description: The lower its health drops, the deadlier its crits climb. Little defense to slow the spiral.

name: Dark Knight
lore: Cavalry officers sent to the court circle for tomes come back quiet and ride harder into the first blow. Their horses will not take the temple roads.
roleChange: Gains Tomes, Fiendish Blow innate, mixed offense
description: Rides with tome magic now, Fiendish Blow lending extra bite whenever it opens the attack.

name: Bow Knight
lore: Skirmish riders of the open marches: arrive, argue, leave.
description: Bow from the saddle, sword up close, and Skirmisher rewarding every opening strike.

name: Warlock
lore: Restricted-stack slip: borrower may keep the book; book may keep the borrower. Whatever a warlock's spell tears out of a foe flows back into the caster.
description: Every hit feeds back a quarter of the damage as health; it wins the long fights.

name: Battle Monk
lore: The temple's answer to a burning world: a staff for the wounded, an axe for whoever wounded them. Brothers beside a battle monk stand noticeably firmer.
roleChange: Gains Axes, Fortify Aura innate, frontline healer
description: An axe for the enemy and a Fortify aura for the friends beside it — healing from the front line.

name: Trickster
lore: Some are thieves who took vows, some are clerics who kept their lockpicks. Parish records list tricksters under both, and the collection plate under neither.
roleChange: Gains Staves, Darting Blow innate, fast utility
description: Staves for support, Darting Blow for speed — a rogue who blurs on the attack.

name: Hunter
lore: Deep-wood families feed the border towns in lean years. The war conscripted their aim and got the patience free, along with the knack for any ground.
roleChange: Gains Bows, Pathfinder innate, terrain master
description: Bows in hand and terrain no obstacle; Pathfinder carries him cheaply across any ground.

name: Zombie
lore: Fen-village rule: burn the dead, or give them to the light. Whatever the corruption keeps will stand up again after the first time it falls.
description: Slow, hard to put down, and it rises once more after falling — unless Light magic does the killing.

name: Revenant
lore: What the fens keep long enough stops shambling. It remembers the axe, the sword, and the hunger, and every wound it opens fills something behind its ribs.
roleChange: Gains Swords, Life Drain innate, stronger undead
description: Stronger than the corpse it was, and every strike siphons the life back into it.

name: Dragon
lore: They slept below the sacred ground longer than any chronicle reaches. The ritual is waking them in the wrong order, and the first ones up are hungry.
description: Vast bulk, and breath that scorches resistance from one tile away or two.

name: Dragon Lord
lore: Eldest of the woken, in scale that has outlasted every kingdom this land has had. It regards the war the way a mountain regards weather.
roleChange: Dragon Scale innate, supreme magical tank
description: Eldest of the woken, its ancient scale blunts every blow that lands.

name: Entity
lore: The thing beneath the stillness. The liturgy has no name for it, only for the shape the world takes when it turns over in its sleep.
description: The horror beneath the stillness fills a three-tile span and strikes from range with two weapons at once.
